theme: Scalable Music Data Pipelines and Feature Stores
description: This research focuses on the data engineering backbone required to support music recommendation systems at scale.
title: Data Engineering Research
outcome: A unified analytical data warehouse capable of supporting downstream machine learning workloads and exploratory data analysis.

theme: Audio Representation Learning for Music Recommendation
description: This research explores how deep learning models understand music directly from audio signals.
title: Machine Learning & Deep Learning Research
outcome: A recommendation pipeline that compares songs using learned audio embeddings rather than relying solely on metadata.
